يلتحمون (form VIII)
# يَلْتَحِمُونَ (yaltaḥimūna) /jal.ta.ħi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# يُلْتَحَمُونَ (yultaḥamūna) /jul.ta.ħa.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
